== Usage ==
'''Subst-only skeleton, not a live template.''' Start a new Field Procedure with a plain Main-namespace title, such as <code>[[Unlocking Broo Tarquin]]</code>, and enter:

<pre>{{subst:New guide page}}</pre>

Substitution creates ordinary, independently editable wikitext. Replace the hidden drafting comments with finished content and remove sections that do not apply before the article moves beyond Draft status.

A Field Procedure explains how to complete a task. It may identify related ships, modules, commodities, Engineers, and mechanics when the procedure needs that context, but their full specifications and background remain on their reference pages. See [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Creating a Guide]] and [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Editorial Policy#Topic ownership and page scope|Topic ownership and page scope]].

Do not publish guessed requirements, quantities, locations, or steps. Keep uncertain mechanics clearly qualified and verify material claims against the live game or a reliable current source.
